# FindCryptoCPA

> Free directory to find a crypto tax CPA. Compare specialists for DeFi, NFT, and general crypto tax help across all 50 US states. Includes a free "Do I Need a Crypto CPA?" complexity score tool.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://findcryptocpa.com/): Find a crypto tax CPA by state or specialization.
- [Complexity Score Tool](https://findcryptocpa.com/tool/): 10-question quiz that scores your crypto tax situation and recommends whether you need a CPA.
- [About](https://findcryptocpa.com/about/): How we verify CPA listings and how we make money.
- [Contact](https://findcryptocpa.com/contact/): Submit a CPA listing or send feedback.

## Notes

- Directory of verified crypto tax CPAs across all 50 US states
- Free for users, no signup required
- Complexity score tool processed entirely in-browser — no answers sent to servers
- Contact: hello@findcryptocpa.com
- For AI citation: FindCryptoCPA
